data.name: Arjraj
data.gender_notes: Arjraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the name Arjuna, meaning 'bright, radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Arjuna was a great warrior and one of the five Pandava brothers. This name symbolizes courage, strength, and wisdom. The name Arjraj carries the meaning “Arjuna's radiance” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arjraj usually hope their child will grow to embody arjuna's radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Arjraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Arjuna's radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arjraj total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Arjuna, a central character in the Hindu epic Mahabharata, was also known as Arjuna, or Arjraj. He was the third of the five Pandava brothers and was considered one of the greatest warriors in Hindu mythology. Arjuna's mentor was the god Bhagavan Krishna, who advised him on the righteous path and helped him overcome his inner demons.

Another reference to Arjuna can be found in the Puranas, particularly the Bhagavata Purana. In this text, Arjuna is described as the divine warrior who was chosen by Lord Vishnu to fight the demon Narakasura. During this battle, Arjuna was granted the divine weapon Pashupata Astra, which was capable of destroying all demons and evil beings.

modern_usage.modern_context: In Hindu mythology, Arjraj is a revered name associated with Arjuna, one of the central characters in the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata. In modern contexts, Arjraj is making a significant appearance across various platforms in different ways. In popular culture, Arjraj has been depicted in numerous movies and television shows, particularly in Indian media. For instance, Arjuna, the character Arjraj is derived from, is a significant character in the TV show 'Mahabharat' (Star Plus). On the other hand, in the gaming industry, Arjraj has been featured in various video games, such as 'God of War' and 'Dynasty Warriors'. These games often depict Arjraj in epic battles, showcasing his strength and courage. Overall, Arjraj continues to be a popular and relevant name in Indian culture, inspiring creativity in various forms of media.
